detailZones.title: Glass teapot
detailZones.description: The clear round pot has a curved handle, a pouring spout and a visible tea line.

detailZones.title: Brewing basket
detailZones.description: The metal basket sits inside the teapot opening, with woven mesh visible above and below the tea.

detailZones.title: Water kettle
detailZones.description: The brushed steel kettle shows a dark handle, triangular spout, water gauge and power base.

detailZones.title: Tea chest
detailZones.description: Rows of colored envelopes stand in the four separate slots of the open wooden organizer.

detailZones.title: Tea bags and tags
detailZones.description: Three paper bags sit in front of the chest, each tied to a separate white paper tag.

detailZones.title: Loose tea and scoop
detailZones.description: Two open tins display dark and green dried leaves beside a round lid and a measuring scoop.

detailZones.title: Honey and milk
detailZones.description: An open honey jar holds a grooved wooden dipper. Milk sits in a small white pitcher beside it.

detailZones.title: Teacup and sugar
detailZones.description: A white cup of tea sits on a saucer with a teaspoon and two separate sugar cubes.

detailZones.title: Sliced lemon
detailZones.description: Two overlapping lemon slices expose their rind, white pith and translucent pulp on a small plate.

detailZones.title: Mint and tea ball
detailZones.description: A mint sprig and a metal tea ball with a fine chain lie on a folded cloth napkin.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final photograph was reviewed for visible tea utensils, loose leaves and serving ingredients. Preparation actions, caffeine content and strength belong in the searchable index.
